literal: Biographies 30: Yuan Shu
idiomatic: Biographies 30: Yuan Shu

literal: Yuan Shu, courtesy name Yangyuan, was a native of Yangxia in Chen Commandery and the youngest son of Bao, Prefect of Danyang.
idiomatic: Yuan Shu, whose courtesy name was Yangyuan, came from Yangxia in Chen Commandery. He was the youngest son of Bao, who had served as Prefect of Danyang.

literal: From youth he had spirit and bearing; when only a few years old, Bo Zhan said to the family: "This is no ordinary child.
idiomatic: Even as a boy he showed spirit and presence. When he was only a few years old, Bo Zhan told the household, "This is no ordinary child.

literal: " When he was more than ten, he won the admiration of Wang Hong, his uncle by marriage.
idiomatic: " By his early teens he had won the admiration of Wang Hong, his uncle by marriage.

literal: He did not pursue the study of exegetical chapters, yet broadly mastered many fields; he loved literary composition—his phrasing was forceful and brilliant, and he had talent for eloquent disputation.
idiomatic: He did not pursue the study of exegetical chapters, yet he mastered many fields through wide reading. He loved to write, and his prose was forceful and brilliant; he also had a gift for eloquent debate.

literal: The provincial authorities appointed him Registrar, Writing Assistant Gentleman, and Attendant-in-Ordinary to the Crown Prince; he accepted none of these posts.
idiomatic: The provincial authorities appointed him Registrar, Writing Assistant Gentleman, and Attendant-in-Ordinary to the Crown Prince, but he accepted none of these posts.

literal: The Prince of Pengcheng, Yikang, appointed him Libationer of the Army Office.
idiomatic: The Prince of Pengcheng, Yikang, appointed him Libationer of the Army Office.

literal: Yikang did not care for literary studies; though outwardly he treated Shu with courtesy, inwardly his regard was very slight.
idiomatic: Yikang cared little for literary studies. Though he treated Shu with outward courtesy, inwardly his regard was very slight.

literal: Liu Zhan, Shu's maternal cousin, wanted Shu to attach himself to him, but Shu paid it no mind; thereby they fell greatly at odds, and Shu was dismissed on account of a long illness.
idiomatic: Liu Zhan, Shu's maternal cousin, wanted Shu to attach himself to him, but Shu paid no heed. They fell sharply at odds, and Shu was dismissed on account of a long illness.

literal: He was appointed Senior Clerk to the Right Army of the Prince of Hengyang, Yiji, then promoted to Groom of the Heir Apparent, but because of a foot ailment he did not take up the office.
idiomatic: He was appointed Senior Clerk to the Right Army of the Prince of Hengyang, Yiji, and was then promoted to Groom of the Heir Apparent, but because of a foot ailment he did not take up the post.

literal: The Inspector-in-Chief of the Guard, the Prince of Linchuan, Yiqing, who greatly delighted in literature, invited him as Consulting Staff Member.
idiomatic: The Inspector-in-Chief of the Guard, the Prince of Linchuan, Yiqing, who greatly delighted in literature, invited him to serve as Consulting Staff Member.

literal: Before long he was transferred to Left Western Attendant of the Minister of Works.
idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to Left Western Attendant of the Minister of Works.

literal: He went out as Administrator of Xuancheng, then entered to fill the post of Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat; he left office on account of his mother's death.
idiomatic: He went out as Administrator of Xuancheng, then returned to the capital as Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat, and left office to observe mourning for his mother.

literal: When mourning ended, he became Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
idiomatic: When mourning ended, he became Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.

literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia he was transferred to Director of Personnel in the Ministry of Works.
idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia he was transferred to Director of Personnel in the Ministry of Works.

literal: That autumn there was a great northern expedition; Shu, sitting in attendance, said with ease: "Now is the time to sound the imperial carriage at Mount Song, sweep through Zhao and Wei, and examine the jade at Mount Tai.
idiomatic: That autumn the court launched a great northern expedition. Shu, sitting in attendance, said with easy confidence, "Now is the time to sound the imperial carriage at Mount Song, sweep through Zhao and Wei, and present jade at Mount Tai.

literal: Your servant meets an age once in a thousand years and wishes to present a 'Treatise on the Feng and Shan Sacrifices.'
idiomatic: Your servant has met an age that comes once in a thousand years, and I wish to present a Treatise on the Feng and Shan Sacrifices.

literal: " The Taizu laughed and said: "For a deed of vast virtue—I am not worthy to undertake it.
idiomatic: " The Taizu laughed and said, "A deed of such vast virtue is more than I am worthy to undertake.

literal: " He went out as Chief of Staff on the Northern Campaign Staff of the Prince of Shixing and Administrator of Eastern South Sea.
idiomatic: " He then went out as Chief of Staff on the Northern Campaign Staff of the Prince of Shixing and as Administrator of Eastern South Sea.

literal: When Shu first arrived at the princely establishment, Jun summoned him for an audience and said: "I did not expect my uncle to condescend to serve as assistant.
idiomatic: When Shu first arrived at the princely establishment, Jun summoned him for an audience and said, "I never expected my uncle to condescend to serve as my assistant.

literal: " Shu replied: "The court dispatched your humble servant precisely to lend brilliance to the prestige of your establishment.
idiomatic: " Shu replied, "The court dispatched your humble servant precisely to lend brilliance to the prestige of your establishment.

literal: " He returned to serve as Censor-in-Chief.
idiomatic: " He then returned to the capital to serve as Censor-in-Chief.

literal: At that time the barbarian Wei were invading south and had reached Guabu; the Taizu had the hundred officials discuss methods of defense; Shu submitted a memorial saying:
idiomatic: At that time the northern enemy invaded south as far as Guabu. The Taizu had the hundred officials discuss methods of defense, and Shu submitted a memorial saying:

literal: Your servant has heard that beasts of the land in wheeled cages, once they leave the mountains, are bound to perish;
idiomatic: Your servant has heard that beasts of the land, once caged and taken from the mountains, are bound to perish;

literal: fish that break the waves, once the current is checked, wither.
idiomatic: and fish that ride the waves, once the current is checked, wither away.

literal: The remnant villainy of the Jie raiders has rushed to the capital region; they gather like ants and swarm like locusts—I hear they are already collapsing.
idiomatic: The remnant villainy of the Jie raiders has rushed into the capital region. They gather like ants and swarm like locusts, and I hear they are already near collapse.

literal: Heaven's barriers are lofty and remote, the earth's limits deep and far—hence all Wei held back its designs, and flourishing Jin stayed its counsel; intent bent and strength spent, spirit blunted and courage exhausted—they surely did not anticipate a sudden coming, and from the first had no fear they could succeed.
idiomatic: Heaven's barriers are lofty and remote, and the earth's limits deep and far. Hence all Wei once held back its designs, and flourishing Jin stayed its counsel. Their intent was bent and their strength spent, their spirit blunted and their courage exhausted. They surely did not anticipate a sudden invasion, and from the first they had no fear that they could succeed.

literal: Recently, in pacifying and settling the distant west, they defied our military law; because generals were lax or clumsy, the troops lacked fighting will.
idiomatic: Recently, while pacifying and settling the distant west, they defied our military law. Because the generals were lax or clumsy, the troops lost their will to fight.

literal: Besieged masses were not overthrown by the enemy's rush; strike forces vanished of their own accord in disarray; the fierce cavalry west of the Ji fled in hot battle; the trained soldiers on the Huai were picked clean and their banners went empty.
idiomatic: Besieged masses were not overthrown by the enemy's rush, while strike forces scattered of their own accord. The fierce cavalry west of the Ji fled in hot battle, and the trained soldiers on the Huai were thinned until their banners stood empty.

literal: Thus harmony was maintained in few hearts, martial glory in much confusion; thereby the deep gorges brought calamity inland, springs and rivers brought disturbance—Ji culture was torn apart, Yu's legacy was poisoned; urgent dispatches pressed the land west of the Wei, beacon fires matched the alarms at Xianyang.
idiomatic: Thus harmony was kept in few hearts while martial glory was lost in much confusion. Deep gorges brought calamity inland, and springs and rivers brought disturbance. The culture of Ji was torn apart and the legacy of Yu was poisoned. Urgent dispatches pressed the land west of the Wei, and beacon fires matched the alarms at Xianyang.

literal: Yet probing carefully reality and pretense, hidden things were first revealed; examining means and skills, deceit was already exposed.
idiomatic: Yet once reality and pretense were carefully probed, what was hidden was first revealed; once means and skills were examined, deceit was already exposed.

literal: A thousand li of territory, yet marching is blocked and deep; inside and outside they stumble and choke, rear and front hem them in.
idiomatic: Though their territory spans a thousand li, every march is blocked and deep. Within and without they stumble and choke, and before and behind they are pressed on every side.

literal: They abandon the habit of hill and plain and vie for the advantage of rushing sand.
idiomatic: They have abandoned the habit of hill and plain and now vie for the advantage of rushing sand.

literal: Now the rainbow appears and duckweed sprouts, the soil is moist and springs stir; roads and fords sink and overflow, pestilence arises again and again; fodder is already gone, grain cannot be tied up; the water realm girdles them—advancing they must topple and perish, the river barrier narrow and firm—retreating they likewise sink to destruction.
idiomatic: Now the rainbow appears and duckweed sprouts, the soil turns moist and springs stir. Roads and fords sink and overflow, and pestilence rises again and again. Fodder is already gone and grain cannot be secured. The water realm girdles them: if they advance they must topple and perish; if they retreat, the narrow river barrier will likewise swallow them to destruction.

literal: It is what people call roosting birds upon blazing fire and raising fish amid thorn thickets.
idiomatic: This is what people call roosting birds upon blazing fire and raising fish amid thorn thickets.

literal: Some say to lessen defenses on the Jiang's right and widen preparations within the Huai.
idiomatic: Some say the court should lessen defenses on the Jiang's right and widen preparations within the Huai.

literal: I venture that holding fast to the Min region's frontier was approved in old histories; abandoning distant Liang warriors was denounced in earlier words.
idiomatic: I venture that holding fast to the Min frontier was approved in old histories, while abandoning distant Liang warriors was denounced in earlier words.

literal: Constrained to this vital wilderness, still they were not allowed to be surrendered.
idiomatic: Even when constrained to that vital wilderness, the court still did not allow it to be surrendered.

literal: How much more when the capital itself is stricken, the sacred precinct within a stone's throw—how many prefectures have been swept bare, how many towns maimed; mountains and rivers overturned, vegetation painted with dead flesh.
idiomatic: How much more now, when the capital itself is stricken and the sacred precinct lies within a stone's throw. How many prefectures have been swept bare and how many towns maimed! Mountains and rivers have overturned, and vegetation is painted with the flesh of the dead.

literal: Now the levy from households fills a thousand chariots, market tallies gather in ten thousands; shoulders rub closer than in Chang'an, gathered sleeves outnumber Linzi—the one-in-ten register truly satisfies the people's wish; taxing by the cultivated mu already suits the farmer's peace.
idiomatic: Now the levy from households fills a thousand chariots, and market tallies gather in ten thousands. Shoulders rub closer than in Chang'an, and gathered sleeves outnumber Linzi. The one-in-ten register truly satisfies the people's wish, and taxing by the cultivated mu already suits the farmer's peace.

literal: Every household competes in fighting spirit, every person holds a keen will—all wish to win grain and beg to charge, to throw off weaving and take the wall.
idiomatic: Every household competes in fighting spirit, and every person holds a keen will. All wish to carry extra grain and beg to charge, to throw off weaving and man the walls.

literal: Say that gold should be hung and seals cast to summon stalwart fighters; heavy coin and sweet words to recruit men who will smash and decide; raise them from below the plasterer's scaffold, draw them from among the black-robed attendants on the tower—reward them with the burning of books, repay them with the prime minister's fief—and soon bright talent will fill the gate, unusual ability will arrive one after another.
idiomatic: Hang gold and cast seals to summon stalwart fighters. Offer heavy coin and sweet words to recruit men who will smash the enemy and decide the day. Raise them from below the plasterer's scaffold and draw them from among the black-robed attendants on the tower. Reward them with the burning of books and repay them with the prime minister's fief, and soon bright talent will fill the gate and unusual ability will arrive one after another.

literal: The barbarians are greedy and without stratagem, unrestrained and unformed; lost in the order of turning toward and away, mistaken in fitting union and dispersion—they have touched the utmost harm of military codes and the greatest taboo of the art of war.
idiomatic: The northerners are greedy and without stratagem, unrestrained and unformed. Lost in the order of turning toward and away, mistaken in fitting union and dispersion, they have touched the utmost harm of military codes and the greatest taboo of the art of war.

literal: All store up their wrath; all plan for battle; they call out wishing to follow like a shadow, ballads speak of pledging their lives.
idiomatic: All store up their wrath and all plan for battle. They call out wishing to follow like a shadow, and ballads speak of pledging their lives.

literal: Choose several thousand bold and fierce, gallop in secret concealment, lower banners and wrap armor, bridled horses with gags in the mouth; rise at roll-call with the dawn pressing on their camp before they are formed—banners clamor and disorder breaks out, fires and drums close in on all sides—so that the foe has no time to shift his gaze, no time for dust to rise; none will fail to be captured and slaughtered like trembling beasts, melting like ice and dispersing like mist; sweep away the lookout bands, float the brine and flood the hills.
idiomatic: Choose several thousand bold and fierce men, gallop in secret concealment, lower banners and wrap armor, and set bridled horses with gags in their mouths. Rise at roll-call and at dawn press on their camp before it is formed. Let banners clamor and disorder break out, and let fires and drums close in on all sides, so that the foe has no time to shift his gaze and no time for dust to rise. None will fail to be captured and slaughtered like trembling beasts, melting like ice and dispersing like mist. Sweep away the lookout bands and float the brine until it floods the hills.

literal: Should any slip the net like a condemned criminal, linger in a nest or hide in a hole—order Huai and Ru boats with halberds to block their return road, and Yan Province's crack troops to choke their homeward path.
idiomatic: Should any slip the net like a condemned criminal and linger in a nest or hide in a hole, order the Huai and Ru boats with halberds to block their return road, and Yan Province's crack troops to choke their homeward path.

literal: You will surely cut down the chief villain and hang his head beneath your banners; then not a single wheel will return, not a war chariot will turn back.
idiomatic: You will surely cut down the chief villain and hang his head beneath your banners. Then not a single wheel will return, and not a war chariot will turn back.

literal: Thereupon loyal envoys will spread their prestige and warriors will tighten their strength; painted armor joins in shadow, watch-drums sound in succession.
idiomatic: Thereupon loyal envoys will spread their prestige and warriors will tighten their strength. Painted armor will join in shadow, and watch-drums will sound in succession.

literal: If they feign retreat and feign strength, appearing and vanishing without border—Chu speech and Han banners, manifest and hidden as spirits—already they veil sun and moon, shake valleys and rivers.
idiomatic: If they feign retreat and feign strength, appearing and vanishing without border, with Chu speech and Han banners, manifest and hidden as spirits, already they veil sun and moon and shake valleys and rivers.

literal: As for remnant rebels holding passes, bandits blocking mountains—those who seize defiles and steal life, relying on walls and borrowed earth—then you should roll up your prestige and exploit the moment to mow them down.
idiomatic: As for remnant rebels holding passes and bandits blocking mountains, those who seize defiles and steal life while relying on walls and borrowed earth, you should roll up your prestige and exploit the moment to mow them down.

literal: The fine warriors of Si and Bian will stream like stars and flash like lightning; Yan and Fu will muster strict troops, gathering like rain and clouds—trampling disorder north of Sang Creek, rocking collapse south of Huan River—cutting off their heart-root so they cannot take hold again; withers bound by rope, how can they fail to rot?
idiomatic: The fine warriors of Si and Bian will stream like stars and flash like lightning. Yan and Fu will muster strict troops, gathering like rain and clouds, trampling disorder north of Sang Creek and rocking collapse south of Huan River. Cut off their heart-root so they cannot take hold again. Withers bound by rope—how can they fail to rot?

literal: Thus is it like draining the marsh to fish and burning the forest to hunt—like a piercing wind shaking light bamboo slips, like bright sun brushing floating frost.
idiomatic: Thus it will be like draining the marsh to fish and burning the forest to hunt, like a piercing wind shaking light bamboo slips, like bright sun brushing floating frost.

literal: Then pacify those who remain from plunder among the lotuses, gaze in condolence upon ghosts netted in sorrow.
idiomatic: Then pacify those who remain from plunder among the lotuses and gaze in condolence upon ghosts netted in sorrow.

literal: After that heaven moves the pivot of fate, tempest rises and smoke ascends—the blue canopy tours west, the emerald pennant journeys east—opening and cleansing the provinces and wilds, washing clean in one sweep of the whip—so that the high gate is inscribed again and Yanran marked afterward.
idiomatic: After that heaven will move the pivot of fate, tempest will rise and smoke ascend. The blue canopy will tour west and the emerald pennant journey east, opening and cleansing the provinces and wilds and washing them clean in one sweep of the whip, so that the high gate is inscribed again and Yanran marked afterward.

literal: Only then sink the mountain and sink the river, create rites and compile records, radiate the surviving rules of Yan and Hao, thread through and surpass the old texts of Shang and Xia.
idiomatic: Only then will you sink offerings at the mountain and river, create rites and compile records, radiate the surviving rules of Yan and Hao, and thread through and surpass the old texts of Shang and Xia.

literal: Now the masses possess martial valor, yet generals are lax and timid in method—may it be that long peace has accumulated day by day, years of undisturbed rule prolonged; no town has the urgency of answering alarm bells, no household the diligence of supplying war; the rites of drill and inspection are wanting, the ornaments of review and assignment are scant—and perhaps the method of recommended selection is not yet thorough?
idiomatic: Now the masses possess martial valor, yet generals are lax and timid in method. May it be that long peace has accumulated day by day and years of undisturbed rule have grown prolonged, so that no town feels the urgency of answering alarm bells and no household keeps the diligence of supplying war. The rites of drill and inspection are wanting, and the ornaments of review and assignment are scant. Perhaps the method of recommended selection is not yet thorough?

literal: If within the state's crafting, in village selection, one plumbs discourse to the depth, personally tests the utmost hidden, cuts the sash to seek the far—suppose there is one with profound clarity that shines, commanding talent that declares itself, sincerity that moves spring rains and flows through metal and stone, spirit that awes Fei and Ben, knowing that reaches Ju and Qi, discerning the numbers of wrong and right, bent and straight, understanding the fitting of obscurity and brightness, loss and gain, able to harmonize the people's hearts and know dull and sharp natures of things—ascend the red terrace and spread strategies, tread green rush and raise counsel above, persuading the celestial mirror below quieting plain words—enough to settle the people and ease the state, rescue disaster and pity the afflicted.
idiomatic: If, within the state's crafting and in village selection, one plumbs discourse to the depth, personally tests the utmost hidden, and cuts the sash to seek the far, suppose there is one whose profound clarity shines forth and whose commanding talent declares itself, whose sincerity moves spring rains and flows through metal and stone, whose spirit awes Fei and Ben, whose knowing reaches Ju and Qi, who discerns the numbers of wrong and right, bent and straight, who understands the fitting of obscurity and brightness, loss and gain, who can harmonize the people's hearts and know the dull and sharp natures of things, who ascends the red terrace and spreads strategies and treads green rush to raise counsel above, persuading the celestial mirror and below quieting plain words—such a one would be enough to settle the people and ease the state, rescue disaster and pity the afflicted.

literal: Then he should be pulled above favored nobility, honored and promoted above kin of merit—given his own banner and insignia, glory in his rank and salary; going forth he may claim sole authority, orders need not be received.
idiomatic: Then he should be pulled above favored nobility and honored and promoted above kin of merit. Give him his own banner and insignia and glory in rank and salary. Let him go forth with sole authority, without needing to receive orders.

literal: Lower his mat and bend his joint, as at Guangwu's request;
idiomatic: Lower your mat and bend your joint, as at Guangwu's request;

literal: raise an altar and perform rites, equal to bestowing command at Huaiyin.
idiomatic: raise an altar and perform rites, equal to bestowing command at Huaiyin.

literal: There will surely be the achievement of covenant oath, the success of stealing the tally.
idiomatic: There will surely be the achievement of a covenant oath and the success of stealing the tally.

literal: The barbarian tribes are violent and cruel, deserted within and without; those first attached are without order in division; inflamed by authority and profit, they are bound to split apart; those who led the way will of themselves reach you.
idiomatic: The barbarian tribes are violent and cruel and deserted within and without. Those first attached are without order in division. Inflamed by authority and profit, they are bound to split apart, and those who led the way will of themselves come over to you.

literal: Now distill the old canons, rinse the soil and tether; shear and scatter the hidden, cut off the heads of the fierce and cunning.
idiomatic: Now distill the old canons, rinse the soil and tether, shear and scatter the hidden, and cut off the heads of the fierce and cunning.

literal: It is like the near-sighted longing for brightness, the lame longing to walk—when the merchant pitch sounds, achievement at last is easy to feel.
idiomatic: It is like the near-sighted longing for brightness and the lame longing to walk: when the merchant pitch sounds, achievement at last is easy to feel.

literal: Seizing Jin lay in keen observation; preserving Zheng truly rested on good spies—multiply wandering agents, muddy and confuse their hearts and ears; send before danger and easy, strike with arts of rise and fall; pierce their suspicions hidden, brush their dislikes cherished; muddy them with the honor of joint command, bait them with the asset of carved territory.
idiomatic: Seizing Jin lay in keen observation, and preserving Zheng truly rested on good spies. Multiply wandering agents and muddy and confuse their hearts and ears. Send counsel before danger and ease, and strike with the arts of rise and fall. Pierce their hidden suspicions and brush their cherished dislikes. Muddy them with the honor of joint command and bait them with the asset of carved territory.

literal: Exhaust the uses of the brush tip, unfold the sharp edge of rhetoric—shake debate and solid walls can be opened, fly the letter and steep towns easily topple.
idiomatic: Exhaust the uses of the brush tip and unfold the sharp edge of rhetoric. Shake debate and solid walls can be opened; fly the letter and steep towns easily topple.

literal: Surely the granary-like storehouse will crumble within, branches and trunks split like tiles—thus Yan and Yue regretted each other, Xiang and Fan came to mutual doubt.
idiomatic: Surely the granary-like storehouse will crumble within and branches and trunks will split like tiles. Thus Yan and Yue regretted each other, and Xiang and Fan came to mutual doubt.

literal: Or again words few yet achievement deep, matter near yet response wide—Qi lord turned the carriage, Zhao nursed and returned the lord—entirely the way of street recitation, fully the effect of exhausting ability.
idiomatic: Or again, though words be few the achievement is deep, though the matter be near the response is wide: the lord of Qi turned his carriage, and Zhao nursed and returned its lord. Entirely this is the way of street recitation and fully the effect of exhausting ability.

literal: Your servant is fortunate to have come from the inner layered prohibitions and to roam the heart in a bright age—favor has kept pace with the body, grace has moved with the years; he has no means to meet and welcome an auspicious fortune, to moisten and adorn the grand law.
idiomatic: Your servant is fortunate to have come from the inner layered prohibitions and to roam the heart in a bright age. Favor has kept pace with my body and grace has moved with the years, yet I have no means to meet and welcome an auspicious fortune or to moisten and adorn the grand law.

literal: Now on the road are arrows left behind, scorpions and bees not yet stilled—I venture to bring forth modest views and repay a little the broad bestowal.
idiomatic: Now on the road lie arrows left behind, and scorpions and bees are not yet stilled. I venture to bring forth modest views and repay a little the broad bestowal.

literal: Yet sitting in the tent there is lack of Zhao Wen, removing helm cannot bring result—I have observed the border discourse of the Chief Protector, the military stratagems of the Court of Dependencies, the resisting words of Zhong and Chao, the matter-speeches of Du and Geng—all say that reaching the thorn of the classics still lacks the upper calculation, and the respect of Zhu's outer wall barely adopts the lower stratagem.
idiomatic: Yet sitting in the tent there is lack of Zhao Wen, and removing the helm cannot bring result. I have observed the border discourse of the Chief Protector, the military stratagems of the Court of Dependencies, the resisting words of Zhong and Chao, and the policy speeches of Du and Geng. All say that reaching the thorn of the classics still lacks the upper calculation, and the respect shown at Zhu's outer wall barely adopts the lower stratagem.

literal: I myself am ashamed at timid wood, wisdom not weaving the minute—I venture to disclose a dark view, without meeting bright selection.
idiomatic: I myself am ashamed at timid wood and wisdom that does not weave the minute. I venture to disclose a dark view, without meeting bright selection.

literal: Shu delighted in grand and extravagant discourse and was often mocked by men of the time.
idiomatic: Shu delighted in grand and extravagant discourse and was often mocked by men of the time.

literal: The Prince of Shixing, Jun, once sent thirty thousand cash to supply Shu; after one night he again sent to recover it, saying the messenger had erred and intending to tease Shu.
idiomatic: The Prince of Shixing, Jun, once sent thirty thousand cash to supply Shu. After one night he sent again to recover it, saying the messenger had erred and intending to tease Shu.

literal: Shu wrote to Jun: "Yuan, Director of the Secretariat, viewing the lodging-house, ventures to lodge a letter with the palace steward of the upper state.
idiomatic: Shu wrote to Jun, "Yuan, Director of the Secretariat, viewing the lodging-house, ventures to lodge a letter with the palace steward of the upper state.

literal: Recently you wrongly sent a spring levy, lowering it upon our poor district.
idiomatic: Recently you wrongly sent a spring levy, lowering it upon our poor district.

literal: Our poor district respectfully attends to the matter and dares not be double-minded.
idiomatic: Our poor district respectfully attends to the matter and dares not be double-minded.

literal: We fear it is not the gift of suburban presentation or the resource for audience and feast; we did not expect the king's grace in this, and therefore there is confusion.
idiomatic: We fear it is not the gift of suburban presentation or the resource for audience and feast. We did not expect the king's grace in this, and therefore there is confusion.

literal: We did not imagine that within the space of a day and night a note of a foot's breadth would issue, and through your attendants a request would be made, thinking the grant had missed its intent and therefore hastening the first gift.
idiomatic: We did not imagine that within the space of a day and night a note of a foot's breadth would issue, and through your attendants a request would be made, thinking the grant had missed its intent and therefore hastening the first gift.

literal: For a dependent minister and one of slight learning and lonely hearing such as I, how could there be doubt?
idiomatic: For a dependent minister and one of slight learning and lonely hearing such as I, how could there be doubt?

literal: Moreover I have heard in former records that within seven years, one grant and one withdrawal—even a man of righteousness might find fault.
idiomatic: Moreover I have heard in former records that within seven years, one grant and one withdrawal—even a man of righteousness might find fault.

literal: How much more when it is close within a ten-day span—how sudden the increase and decrease!
idiomatic: How much more when it is close within a ten-day span—how sudden the increase and decrease!

literal: I fear that the two or three feudal lords may thereby observe the government of the great state.
idiomatic: I fear that the two or three feudal lords may thereby observe the government of the great state.

literal: Therefore I venture to lay bare my inmost heart.
idiomatic: Therefore I venture to lay bare my inmost heart.

literal: My poor house and weak life polish the node and are pure and clean; I love what is pure and straight and, because I am not crooked, my poverty is known throughout the realm.
idiomatic: My poor house and weak life polish the node and are pure and clean. I love what is pure and straight, and because I am not crooked my poverty is known throughout the realm.

literal: Could there be one blind who sighs over gold?
idiomatic: Could there be one blind who sighs over gold?

literal: Unworthily I supply the levy, bind horses and first present disks and await command.
idiomatic: Unworthily I supply the levy, bind horses and first present disks, and await command.

literal: Only let the steward take thought for it."
idiomatic: Only let the steward take thought for it."

literal: He was transferred to Left Commandant of the Heir Apparent's Guard.
idiomatic: He was transferred to Left Commandant of the Heir Apparent's Guard.

literal: The murderer was about to commit regicide; that night Shu was on night duty; at the second watch he summoned Shu and Xiao Bin and others, and with tears said: "The emperor trusts slander and is about to punish and depose me.
idiomatic: The murderer was about to commit regicide. That night Shu was on night duty. At the second watch he summoned Shu and Xiao Bin and others and, weeping, said, "The emperor trusts slander and is about to punish and depose me.

literal: Looking within, I have no fault and cannot accept wrongful ruin.
idiomatic: Looking within, I have no fault and cannot accept wrongful ruin.

literal: Tomorrow morning I shall at once carry out the great affair; I hope you will join your strength with mine.
idiomatic: Tomorrow morning I shall at once carry out the great affair. I hope you will join your strength with mine.

literal: " Shu and Bin both said: "From antiquity there has never been this; I beg you to think more carefully.
idiomatic: " Shu and Bin both said, "From antiquity there has never been this. I beg you to think more carefully.

literal: " Shao grew angry and changed color, and those at his side all stirred.
idiomatic: " Shao grew angry and changed color, and those at his side all stirred.

literal: Bin was afraid and then said: "Your servant formerly served at your side and often thought to repay you with loyal effort; now that distress presses so close, I shall at once exhaust body and obey command.
idiomatic: Bin was afraid and then said, "Your servant formerly served at your side and often thought to repay you with loyal effort. Now that distress presses so close, I shall at once exhaust my body and obey your command.
